must_flow.name: keep_filename_path_join_must_flow

must_not_flow.name: no_capture_of_filename_kw_must_not_flow

must_kill.name: keep_filename_guard_disabled_must_kill

notes: must_flow: Captures the user-controlled 'filename' via FormParser(..., file_name=filename), propagates through self._file_base/self._ext to fname, joins into path under 'if file_dir is not None and keep_filename:', and calls open(path, "w+b"). This matches CTPC edges cap_formparser_file_name_kw -> assign_file_name_to__file_base/_ext -> assign_* -> path_join_keep_filename -> sink_open_path_argument.

must_not_flow: A nearby unsupported path uses the user input only as parser.write(data) bytes; file_name=None means no capture at the constructor. The CTPC should not treat write(data) as a source, so no taint reaches open(path,...).

must_kill: Even though file_name=filename is provided and internal base/ext are set, the code never performs the guarded os.path.join(file_dir, fname); instead it builds a fixed safe path, modeling keep_filename disabled. Without the path_join_keep_filename edge, taint cannot reach open(path,...), yielding no finding.
